ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can record data and generate test reports automatically, but technicians still collect samples, calibrate instruments, and review abnormal results.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 18,600 agricultural and food science technicians employed in 2024, rising to a projected 19,400 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 800 jobs and about 2,900 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $46,800 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace agricultural and food science technicians, but it will change their work. Sample registration, data entry, and report generation are becoming automated, shifting technicians from recording toward operating equipment, enforcing quality, and reviewing results. Hands-on instrument skill, judgment about abnormal data, and proper field sampling are difficult to automate. Technicians who understand both equipment and data become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Widespread adoption of smart testing instruments
ai_s3_list: Sampling and sample-processing standards: accurate measurements are useless if the sample is wrong.
Instrument operation and calibration: people monitor equipment condition to ensure reliable data.
Judgment about abnormal data: experience distinguishes sample problems from operating errors.
Communication with field and production teams: people coordinate sampling timing and conditions.
Implementation of quality systems: people execute certification, traceability, and corrective actions.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means automation is taking over about half of the desk-based work, including registration, records, and reports.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high risk. AI handles data tasks, while equipment operation and quality control remain. Instruments, sampling, and review become more important. Pure recordkeeping roles shrink, while technicians who operate equipment, exercise judgment, and understand quality systems remain resilient.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study food science, agriculture, chemistry, or biology and seek internships in laboratories and testing organizations. Develop skill with precision instruments and quality-system certification, not only classroom theory.

Master smart testing instruments and LIMS. Advance toward quality certification and laboratory management. Move from recording data to an integrated role in operation, review, and quality control, and earn relevant testing credentials.

A background in food science, chemistry, or biology helps. Without one, enter through sample processing and basic testing. On your resume, specify the instruments you operated, testing batches you completed, and abnormalities you resolved.

Do not hire technicians based only on education. Evaluate practical instrument skills and quality awareness. Candidates who produce reliable reports, resolve abnormal data, and understand quality-system processes are the scarcest.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Rapid screening for pesticide and veterinary drug residues
Track samples across the full process
Quality-control charts and internal audit records

ai_s7_trends: Testing automation and smart instruments shift technicians from manual recording toward equipment operation and data quality control.
Stricter food-safety regulation and food-industry upgrades sustain testing demand and expand third-party laboratories.
Deeper laboratory digitization makes LIMS and AI-assisted review standard, increasing demand for quality-system certification skills.

body: Agricultural and food science technicians assist scientists with agricultural and food experiments and testing, including sample collection and processing, physical, chemical, and microbiological testing, instrument operation, data recording, and quality control.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can record data and generate test reports automatically, but technicians still collect samples, calibrate instruments, and review abnormal results.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动录数据、一键生成检测报告，但样品怎么取、仪器怎么校、异常结果怎么复核，还得靠技术员的手和眼。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年农业与食品科学技术员在岗约 1.86 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 1.94 万人，净增约 0.08 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.29 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.68 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代农业与食品科学技术员，但会改变工作内容。样本登记、数据录入、报告生成正被自动化，技术员从「记录」转向「操作、把关、复核」。仪器操作的手感、异常数据的判断、现场取样规范，是机器替代不了的——懂设备又会看数据的技术员反而更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助异常数据识别
实验室信息管理系统全面化
ai_s2_auto: 样本登记与编号自动化
ai_s3_list: 取样与样品处理规范：样没采对，测得再准也没用。
仪器操作与校准：数据可信度靠人盯仪器状态。
异常数据的判断：是样品问题还是操作问题，靠经验。
现场与生产线沟通：取样时机、条件配合，靠人协调。
质量体系的落地：认证、追溯、整改，靠人执行。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业有一半桌面任务正被自动化——登记、记录、报告，AI 和软件都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接管的是「数据」环节，留下的是「操作与把关」环节——仪器、取样、复核反而更重要。真正被压缩的是纯记录整理岗，会操作、会判断、懂体系的技术员更稳。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选食品科学、农学、化学、生物相关专业，多进实验室和检测机构实习。把精密仪器操作和体系认证知识都练起来，别只停留在理论课。
把智能检测仪器和 LIMS 系统用熟，往体系认证、实验室管理方向走。从「记录数据」升级为「操作+复核+质控」三合一，考检验检测相关资质。
有食品、化学、生物背景最好，无背景可从样品处理和基础检测岗切入。简历上多写「操作过哪些仪器、做过多少批次检测、处理过哪些异常」。
招技术员别只看学历，要看仪器实操和质控意识。能稳定出报告、处理异常数据、又懂体系流程的候选人，是最稀缺的。

ai_s7_trends: 检测自动化与智能仪器普及，技术员从「手动记录」转向「仪器操作+数据把关」。
食品安全监管趋严、食品工业升级，检测需求持续增长，第三方检测机构扩张。
实验室数字化深化，LIMS 与 AI 辅助复核成为标配，体系认证人才吃香。

body: 农业与食品科学技术员协助科学家开展农业与食品领域的试验与检测，负责样本采集处理、理化与微生物检验、仪器操作、数据记录和质量控制。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能自动录数据、一键生成检测报告，但样品怎么取、仪器怎么校、异常结果怎么复核，还得靠技术员的手和眼。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI monitoring can track dozens of parameters and warn early, but members of the anesthesia team still decide whether an alert needs immediate action and whether a patient's condition can tolerate surgery.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data shows about 162,700 Anesthesiologist Assistants employed in 2024, rising to a projected 195,800 by 2034. That is a net gain of roughly 33,100 jobs and about 12,000 openings each year, with a 2026 median annual wage near $133,300 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Anesthesiologist Assistants. Anesthesia is high-risk clinical care, and medication, airway management, and intraoperative judgment depend on a trained team. Only licensed professionals can carry responsibility. AI can automate monitoring records and abnormal alerts, but machines cannot remain at the patient's side ready to intervene.
ai_s2_accel: AI monitoring alerts identify risk earlier
Smart infusion systems deliver precise medication doses
Wider use of electronic anesthesia records
ai_s2_auto: Digital anesthesia documentation and medication lists
Automated scheduling and surgical information management
ai_s3_list: Intraoperative judgment: clinical interpretation of abnormal signs.
Airway management: hands-on intubation and ventilation experience.
Emergency teamwork: coordinated response to unexpected conditions.
Careful precision: zero errors in medication and records.
Communication and reassurance: speak with patients before and after surgery.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score identifies anesthesia team roles as high-risk clinical careers where AI clearly improves efficiency without replacing the core. Monitoring records and alerts are automated, but intraoperative judgment, airway procedures, and emergency response still depend on human training and experience. People also retain responsibility.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure makes tools especially valuable. AI monitoring alerts and smart medication delivery can meaningfully increase safety margins, helping anesthesia teams handle more complex surgery. Tools remain support systems; clinical foundations and real-time judgment sustain the profession.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For the U.S. AA path, study pre-medicine or a science major and understand each program's prerequisite and tuition requirements. On the Chinese mainland, related anesthesia paths include anesthesia nursing or clinical medicine. Families should understand that the path requires major investment and high thresholds but offers stable, valuable team roles.

Master intelligent monitoring and electronic anesthesia records, then deepen expertise in complex surgery, geriatric anesthesia, or pediatric anesthesia. Maintain hands-on airway and emergency response practice because no system replaces those core skills.

People with nursing, anesthesia nursing, or medical backgrounds can consider anesthesia team roles. U.S. AAs need a specialized degree; on the Chinese mainland, anesthesia nurse training provides a path. In interviews, emphasize operating room experience, resilience, and teamwork.

Anesthesia talent is scarce globally. Retain staff through teaching, reasonable schedules, and career development. Intelligent monitoring and electronic records reduce documentation burdens and preserve staff time for intraoperative care.

ai_s7_trends: AI monitoring and smart drug delivery increase anesthesia safety margins.
Growing global surgical volume drives demand for anesthesia teams.
Anesthesia subspecialists in geriatric, pediatric, and transplant care become more valuable.

body: Anesthesiologist Assistants participate in anesthesia management under anesthesiologist supervision. They conduct preoperative assessment, induction and maintenance, intraoperative vital-sign monitoring, medication and airway management, and postoperative handoffs to support safety.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI monitoring can track dozens of parameters and warn early, but members of the anesthesia team still decide whether an alert needs immediate action and whether a patient's condition can tolerate surgery.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 监护能同时盯住几十个参数并提前报警，但「这个报警要不要立刻处理、患者状态能不能撑住这台手术」——最终判断的还是麻醉团队的人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年麻醉医师助理在岗约 16.27 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 19.58 万人，净增约 3.31 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.20 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 13.33 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代麻醉医师助理：麻醉是高风险临床操作，用药、气道管理和术中判断都依赖训练有素的团队，责任更是只能由持证人员承担。AI 能接管监护数据记录和异常提醒，但「守在患者身边、随时准备处置」这件事，机器替不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 监护预警提前识别风险
智能输注系统精准给药
AI 辅助术前风险评估
ai_s2_auto: 麻醉文书与用药清单电子化
生命体征异常自动报警
排班与手术信息管理自动化
ai_s3_list: 术中判断：异常体征的临床解读。
气道管理：插管与通气的实操经验。
应急配合：突发状况的团队协作。
细心稳准：用药与记录零差错。
沟通安抚：术前术后的患者沟通。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明麻醉团队岗位是「AI 明显提效、但替代不了核心」的高风险临床职业：监护记录和报警被自动化，但术中判断、气道操作和应急处理依然依赖人的训练与经验，责任也只能人来担。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低中分更要拥抱工具：AI 监护预警和智能给药能显著提升安全边际，会用这些系统的麻醉团队能应对更复杂的手术；但工具只是辅助，临床功底和临场判断才是立身之本。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走美国 AA 路线，本科选医学预科或科学类专业，提前了解院校的预科要求和学费。国内想进麻醉领域，可走麻醉护理或临床医学方向。要跟家长讲清楚：这条路投入大、门槛高，但医疗团队岗位稳定、价值高。
把智能监护和电子麻醉记录系统用熟，往复杂手术麻醉、老年与儿科麻醉等细分方向深耕。保持气道管理和应急演练的手感，这是任何系统都替代不了的核心技能。
有护理、麻醉护理或医学背景的可以关注麻醉团队岗位。美国 AA 需要专门学位；国内可从麻醉护士培训路径进入。面试时突出手术室经验、抗压能力和团队协作。
麻醉人才全球性紧缺，用「培养带教 + 合理排班 + 职业发展」留人。给麻醉团队配智能监护与电子记录系统，减轻文书负担，把人力留给术中守护。

ai_s7_trends: AI 监护与智能给药提升麻醉安全边际。
全球手术量增长带动麻醉团队需求。
麻醉亚专科（老年、儿科、移植）人才更吃香。

body: 麻醉医师助理在麻醉医师的监督下参与麻醉管理，完成术前评估、麻醉诱导与维持、术中生命体征监测、用药与气道管理及术后恢复交接，辅助保障手术患者麻醉安全。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Equipment can assist with code reading and maintenance, but technicians remain responsible for disassembly decisions and high-voltage work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 805,600 automotive service technicians and mechanics were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 839,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 33,600 jobs, with approximately 70,000 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $49,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace automotive service technicians, but it will assist with diagnostic code reading and maintenance reminders. Diagnostic tools provide initial assessments and predictive maintenance, shifting technicians from reading codes to resolving difficult faults and repairing electric powertrain systems. Routine parts replacement faces the most pressure, while people who can diagnose problems and handle high-voltage systems become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Early warnings for electric powertrain risks
ai_s3_list: Difficult diagnosis: human judgment remains essential.
Disassembly decisions: human touch remains essential.
High-voltage work: human responsibility protects safety.
Diagram reading and circuit tracing: human experience remains essential.
Client communication: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10, low-moderate, places this career in a repair field with meaningful AI exposure. Code reading is increasingly automated, but disassembly and electric powertrain work preserve an essential role for people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean universal risk. Routine parts replacement and maintenance face displacement, while electric powertrain diagnosis does not. Technicians who can diagnose faults and understand high-voltage systems become scarcer and more valuable as technology advances. People who only change oil face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study automotive repair or new-energy vehicle technology and earn a high-voltage certification early.
Advance from mechanical repair to electric powertrain diagnosis and build a portfolio of cases.
Emphasize diagnostic and electric powertrain skills, and specify the vehicle models you have worked on.
When hiring, assess steady hands and diagram-reading skills. Technicians who can repair electrical systems merit higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Transition to new-energy vehicles.
Widespread adoption of diagnostic equipment.
Growing shortage of electric powertrain technicians.

body: Automotive service technicians and mechanics diagnose faults and maintain and repair vehicles, covering engines, chassis, electrical systems, and electric powertrains. They return vehicles to service and help prevent roadside breakdowns.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Equipment can assist with code reading and maintenance, but technicians remain responsible for disassembly decisions and high-voltage work.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 读码与保养能被设备辅助，但拆装判断与高压处置，还是技师扛。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年汽车维修技师与机械师在岗约 80.56 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 83.92 万人，净增约 3.36 万个岗位，年均产生约 7.00 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.97 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代汽车维修技师，但会辅助故障码读取与保养提醒。诊断仪初判、预测保养，技师从「读码」转向「判疑难、修三电」。真正被挤掉的是纯换件，会诊断会高压的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 疑难诊断：脑子靠人。
拆装判断：手感靠人。
高压处置：安全靠人。
读图查线：经验靠人。
客户沟通：信任靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的维修区——读码被吃，但拆装与三电仍留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于全风险：被替代的是「纯换件保养」，不是「诊断三电」的岗位。会诊断、懂高压的人，反而随技术更稀缺。怕的是只会换机油的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读汽修/新能源，早点考高压证。
从机修升级成三电诊断，攒案例。
突出诊断与三电，写清跟过哪些车型。
选人看手稳与读图，能修电的值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 新能源转型。
诊断设备普及。
三电技师更缺。

body: 汽车维修技师与机械师是围绕车辆故障诊断、保养维护与修理，覆盖发动机、底盘、电气与三电系统，让车重新跑起来、保障出行不被抛路的职业。
career_ai_description_block.heading: 读码与保养能被设备辅助，但拆装判断与高压处置，还是技师扛。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Machines can weigh and label meat, but experienced cutters still decide how to divide a sinewy cut and maximize yield.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 143,100 butchers and meat cutters were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to increase to 144,500 by 2034, a net gain of about 1,400 jobs, with approximately 16,900 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $39,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Butchers And Meat Cutters, but it will take over some supporting work. Automated cutting lines, weighing, labeling, and inventory systems shift skilled workers from pure physical labor toward high-value trimming, custom cuts, and quality control. Lead cutters with strong knife skills and high yields are genuinely scarce.
ai_s2_auto: Automated cutting lines for standard portions
ai_s3_list: Hands-on knife work: machines cannot replicate anatomical judgment and physical feel.
Custom cutting: people adapt to nonstandard orders.
Yield control: experience adjusts fat and lean proportions.
Quality judgment: people assess freshness.
Safety and sanitation: people maintain knives and work surfaces.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 3/10, relatively low, means core cutting depends on knife skills while automation handles peripheral tasks.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Relatively low exposure does not permit complacency. Automation replaces standard cutting, not craftsmanship. Lead cutters who trim high-value portions and control yield remain scarce. Entry-level workers limited to simple assembly face the greatest pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Learn under an experienced cutter and build strong knife skills and anatomical knowledge. In the AI era, precise trimming and yield matter more than carrying products.
Advance from ordinary cutting to high-value trimming. Learn yield control, master custom cuts, and become a lead cutter.
Emphasize the portions you have cut and your yield results. Counter and factory experience receive priority.
Hire for knife skills and yield, not strength alone. Lead cutters who independently manage high-value portions deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Factories continue expanding automated cutting lines.
Retail counters still rely on people for custom trimming.
Lead cutters with strong knife skills and high yields become scarcer.

body: Butchers And Meat Cutters divide, trim, and prepare livestock and poultry carcasses by anatomical portion. They weigh, package, and display meat, control yield and loss, and protect product specifications and food safety.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Machines can weigh and label meat, but experienced cutters still decide how to divide a sinewy cut and maximize yield.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 称重贴标能交给机器，但「这块带筋的怎么分、怎么出成高」，还得老师傅上手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年屠宰工肉类切割工在岗约 14.31 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 14.45 万人，净增约 0.14 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.69 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.90 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代屠宰分割工，但会接管部分辅助。自动分割线、称重贴标和库存交给设备后，技工从「纯体力」挪向「高值部位精修、定制分割与品质把控」。真正稀缺的是刀工好、出成高的主刀师傅。
ai_s2_auto: 标准部位的自动分割线
库存与订单的自动排程
损耗与出成的自动统计
ai_s3_list: 现场刀工：部位与手感机器难复制。
定制分割：非标件靠人适应。
出成把控：肥瘦靠经验调。
品质判别：新鲜度靠人看。
安全卫生：刀具与案板靠人守。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业处在低 AI 曝光区——核心分割靠刀工，只有边角被自动化。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光也别躺平：被替代的是「标准件分割」，不是「刀工」。会高值精修、能控出成的主刀永远缺。怕的是只做最简单拼接的初级工。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 去跟师傅打底，把刀工和部位识别练扎实。AI 时代拼的是精修和出成，别只做搬运。
从普通切扩到高值部位精修，学出成控制，把定制件做精，升级成主刀。
突出你分过什么部位、出成多少。有档口和工厂经验优先。
招人看刀工和出成，不止看力气。能独立控高值部位的主刀值得给高薪。

刀工好出成高的主刀更稀缺。

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 226,600 Education Administrators, Postsecondary were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 230,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,900 jobs, with about 15,100 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $104,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary education administrators, but it will eliminate much routine work. Academic systems and intelligent platforms increasingly handle registration, grades, student records, and reports. Administrators add value through program development, accreditation reviews, policy interpretation, and cross-department coordination. These tasks require experience, judgment, and communication.
ai_s2_accel: AI analysis and alerts for student performance
Automated collection of program evaluation metrics
Intelligent question answering for students and faculty
ai_s2_auto: Academic systems automate scheduling and course registration
Online student records, grades, and graduation audits
Automated generation of admissions data and required reports
ai_s3_list: Policy interpretation and implementation: administrators turn evaluation criteria and reform documents into executable plans.
Cross-department coordination: people align academic affairs, departments, and student services.
Program development decisions: opening, closing, or revising programs requires judgment about trends.
Services for students and faculty: machines cannot replace face-to-face explanation and reassurance.
Accreditation preparation: administrators build expertise in organizing evidence and preparing for reviews.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the moderate AI exposure range. Standard processes such as registration, grades, and reports are becoming automated, while program development, evaluation, and policy implementation remain core human work.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure signals a shift for administrators. Roles limited to data entry and process execution are contracting. Build skills in data analysis, evaluation methods, and project management to move from transactional execution into management and operations. AI can then remove routine work rather than threaten the role.

ai_s5_persona.建议: A master's degree is a common threshold for university administration, with educational administration and higher education as relevant fields. Gain experience in student affairs or as an academic assistant, and practice official writing and coordination. Competition is intense, so prepare carefully for recruitment exams.

Build data analysis and quality evaluation skills, and volunteer for program development and assessment projects. Move beyond transaction processing toward unit leadership or specialized management. Administrators who understand data are more resilient in a digital environment.

Universities are gradually broadening degree-field requirements for administrative roles. Candidates with data analysis and project management experience are valued. Start as an academic assistant or data specialist and highlight meetings organized, reports written, and processes improved.

Do not hire administrators only for their ability to tolerate desk work. Prioritize data and project management skills. Specialized rotations and a professional advancement track can develop leaders who execute well and understand policy.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Online student record and degree workflows
Analyze student performance and admissions data
Route official documents for online approval

ai_s7_trends: As digital university management and administrative reform advance, purely transactional roles are contracting and administrative work is shifting toward operations.
Program development and quality evaluation are becoming routine. Administrators who understand data, conduct evaluations, and implement plans are in greater demand.
Changing student demographics are driving more precise university operations. Admissions analysis and academic-risk alerts are becoming standard capabilities.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高校教育行政管理者在岗约 22.66 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 23.05 万人，净增约 0.39 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.51 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.40 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校行政管理者，但会替掉大量事务性工作。选课、成绩、学籍、报表，正被教务系统和智能平台自动处理。留下的价值在专业建设、评估迎检、政策解读和跨部门协调——这些需要经验、判断和沟通的活，机器做不来。

跨部门协调：教务处、院系、学生处之间，靠人来回对齐。

ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光对行政人员是个信号——只做「录数据、跑流程」的岗位在减少。把数据分析、评估方法、项目管理学起来，从「事务执行者」变成「管理运营者」，AI 反而帮你从琐事里解放出来。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想进高校行政，硕士学历是常见门槛，教育管理、高等教育学方向对口。在校期间多参与学生工作、教务助理，练公文和协调能力；竞争激烈，要做好备考准备。
把数据分析和质量评估学起来，主动参与专业建设和评估项目。别停留在「事务岗」，往科室负责人和专项管理方向走，数字化时代懂数据的管理者更稳。
高校行政岗招聘专业限制逐年变宽，有数据分析、项目管理背景的受欢迎。从教务助理、数据专员等岗位切入，突出「组织过会议、写过报告、理清过流程」的经历。
招行政人才别只要求「坐得住」，重点看数据能力和项目管理能力。建议用「专项轮岗 + 职称通道」培养复合型管理干部，留住会干活也懂政策的人。

ai_s7_trends: 高校管理数字化与「放管服」改革推进，纯事务岗位收缩，管理岗位向运营化转型。
专业建设与质量评估常态化，懂数据、会评估、能落地的复合型行政人才更吃香。
生源结构变化推动高校精细化运营，招生分析、学情预警等数据能力成为标配。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate layup plans and monitor curing parameters, but experienced hands still determine how to place fabric on a mold without trapping bubbles.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 18,600 Fiberglass Laminators And Fabricators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 19,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 800 jobs, with about 2,100 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $45,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not eliminate Fiberglass Laminators And Fabricators, but it will change the process. Systems absorb layup planning, material calculations, and cure monitoring. Automated fiber and tape placement (AFP/ATL) also handles some standardized large parts. Small batches, complex shapes, and finishing on large parts still depend on manual work because machines cannot soon replicate the required feel.
ai_s2_accel: Automated fiber and tape placement (AFP/ATL) for standardized large parts
AI vision inspection for bubbles and delamination
Pilot use of robotic grinding and trimming
ai_s2_auto: Software-generated layup plans and material calculations

Automatic monitoring and recording of cure temperature and time
Automatic archiving of inspection data and defects
ai_s3_list: Layup feel: removing bubbles and applying pressure require practiced force and rhythm.
Complex shapes and finishing: machines cannot fully reach curves and corners, so people complete them by hand.
Defect judgment: experienced workers quickly identify bubbles, delamination, and dry fibers.
Process adaptation: workers adjust immediately as resin, temperature, and humidity change.
Occupational-health practice: protective habits and tool care remain human responsibilities.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 indicates low-moderate AI exposure. Systems increasingly handle the occupation's limited desk work, including scheduling, material calculations, and inspection records.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure does not mean high risk. Automated placement targets standardized large parts, while small batches, complex shapes, and manual finishing remain necessary. Repetitive simple layup faces pressure, while skilled workers who read drawings and understand processes gain value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you prefer a vocational route, study composites or molds and seek internships at wind-blade plants or shipyards. Practice layup and drawing interpretation, then learn process fundamentals to advance toward technician roles.

Learn process parameters, inspection standards, and new equipment such as automated placement and vision inspection. Advancing from layup execution to process and inspection skills reduces exposure to repetitive-task automation.
Workers without experience can start as layup assistants and learn cutting and resin mixing. Resumes should quantify products completed, yield achieved, and processes mastered.

Do not hire laminators only for willingness to work. Assess yield and process understanding. Workers who read drawings, control bubbles and delamination, and collaborate with new equipment are worth retaining.

Placement of standardized large parts and higher throughput
Automatic recognition of bubbles, delamination, and other defects

ai_s7_trends: Automated placement is entering large factories. Equipment handles standardized parts, while manual roles concentrate on complex shapes and small batches of higher-value products.
Wind blades, ships, and new-energy vehicles increase composites demand. A shortage remains for skilled laminators who understand processes.
Tighter occupational-health and environmental standards increase protective controls and factory digitization while forcing unsafe workshops out of the market.

缺陷判断：起泡、分层、干纱，老手一眼能看出问题在哪。

职业健康细节：防护习惯、工具保养，这些习惯性动作机器替代不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的桌面事务有限且正被自动化——排产、用料计算、质检记录都有系统代劳。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。自动化铺放瞄准的是规则化大件，小批量、异形件和手工收尾仍是刚需。真正被挤压的是纯重复的简单铺层，会看图纸、懂工艺的熟练工反而更吃香。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不想走学历路线可选技校复合材料或模具专业，实习优先去风叶厂和船厂。重点练铺层手艺和图纸识读，学点工艺知识往技师方向走。
把工艺参数、质检标准和新设备（自动铺放、视觉检测）学起来。从「会铺」升级为「懂工艺、会质检」，就能避开简单重复岗被替代的坑。
无经验可从铺层助手入行，学裁剪调胶起步。简历上多写「铺过哪些产品、达到什么良率、掌握哪些工艺」这类可量化成果。
招层压工别只看「肯干」，要看良率和工艺理解。能看懂图纸、控制气泡分层、配合新设备的工人，比闷头铺布的人更值得留。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 先把First Line Supervisors Of Construction Trades And Extraction Workers基础打牢，积累真实项目。
用既有经验对接First Line Supervisors Of Construction Trades And Extraction Workers，找差异化切口。
把First Line Supervisors Of Construction Trades And Extraction Workers经验产品化/管理化，放大杠杆。
用 AI 解放First Line Supervisors Of Construction Trades And Extraction Workers重复劳动，聚焦决策。

First Line Supervisors Of Construction Trades And Extraction Workers核心作业

career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能吞掉建筑施工主管采掘工人的大量重复与可结构化任务，但判断、责任与人际协调仍由人扛；真正被挤掉的是纯执行层。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can schedule shifts and record inspections, but supervisors still lead teams, calm dissatisfied customers, and monitor service on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 149,100 supervisors employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 159,100 by 2034, a net gain of about 10,000 jobs, with about 16,300 annual openings. The 2026 median annual wage is about $47,100 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace personal service supervisors, but it will reduce administrative tasks. Store management systems accelerate scheduling, attendance, and inspections. Supervisors shift from recording attendance toward leading people, resolving complaints, designing service, and coordinating the floor. Roles limited to scheduling and attendance face pressure. Leaders who can guide teams and recover difficult situations become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: Leadership: people guide the team.
Complaints: people calm emotions.
On-site service: people recover from disruptions.
Training: people transfer standards.
Coordination: people resolve conflicts.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this career in the moderate AI exposure range for management. Systems accelerate scheduling and inspections, while people remain central to leadership and on-site coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not mean high job risk. Automation replaces scheduling and attendance tasks, not the role of leading teams and managing service. Supervisors who can guide people and resolve complaints become scarcer as productivity rises. Roles limited to recording attendance face greater pressure.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Start in frontline service and build communication and leadership skills. Pure scheduling work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop on-site judgment early.
Advance from recording attendance to leading people, resolving complaints, and designing service. Seek responsibility for a larger location.
Highlight frontline experience and leadership examples. State how many people you supervised and which service settings you managed.
Do not assess candidates only by tenure. Look for leadership and recovery skills. Strong employees who stabilize service quality merit higher performance pay.

ai_s7_trends: Store systems spread, reducing scheduling and inspection work.
Leadership and complaint resolution remain essential.
Supervisors who design service become more sought after.

body: First Line Supervisors Of Personal Service Workers coordinate frontline teams in beauty, fitness, cleaning, and other personal service settings. They manage schedules, training, service quality, and complaints to ensure reliable delivery.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Systems can schedule shifts and record inspections, but supervisors still lead teams, calm dissatisfied customers, and monitor service on site.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能排班巡检，但带队伍、抚客诉、盯现场服务，还是主管定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年主管工人在岗约 14.91 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 15.91 万人，净增约 1.00 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.63 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.71 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代个人服务主管，但会压缩事务动作。门店管理系统把排班、考勤、巡检提速，主管从记考勤挪向带人、客诉、服务设计、现场协调。真正被挤掉的是只做排班考勤的，会带人能救场的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 带人：队伍靠人带。
客诉：情绪靠人抚。
现场：波动靠人救。
培训：标准靠人传。
协调：冲突靠人解。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光的管理区——排班巡检被系统加速，但带人和现场协调还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是排班考勤动作，不是带队伍管服务的岗位。会带人、能救客诉的主管，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会记考勤的。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 从一线服务做起，多练沟通和带人，AI 时代纯排班在缩，早点练现场。
从记考勤升级成带人加救客诉加做服务设计，争取管大店。
突出一线经验和带人案例，写清管过多少人和什么业态。
选人别只看资历，要看会不会带人和救场。能稳住服务质量的骨干值得给高绩效。

ai_s7_trends: 门店系统普及，排班巡检缩。
带人救客诉仍是刚需。
会做服务设计的主管更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can draft a translation of a Japanese novel and correct German grammar, but students still need a teacher to understand mono no aware in Kawabata Yasunari's writing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 26,400 Foreign Language And Literature Teachers, Postsecondary employed in 2024. Employment is projected to remain at 26,400 in 2034, with 0 net new jobs and roughly 1,900 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $77,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace Foreign Language And Literature Teachers, Postsecondary, but it will transform what they teach. Machine translation and AI grading challenge instruction limited to language mechanics, turning language from a skill into an entry requirement. Teachers create value through literary interpretation, cross-cultural research, and individual guidance. Using AI for routine work creates more time for close reading and cultural dialogue.
ai_s2_accel: Wider use of intelligent speaking practice
ai_s3_list: Close literary interpretation: AI cannot explain why mono no aware or existentialism moves a reader.
Cross-cultural comparison: people build bridges between cultures.
Guided classroom inquiry: people lead students into another way of thinking.
Individual guidance: teachers understand each student's language gaps and interests.
Academic judgment and originality: people decide what deserves study and whether conclusions are credible.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 6/10 means AI is taking over a substantial share of language-processing tasks. Translation, correction, and practice can be automated, reducing the value of instruction limited to language skills.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate exposure does not equal high risk. Instruction limited to language mechanics faces pressure, while literature, culture, and critical inquiry retain value. Stronger AI translation makes human understanding of another civilization more distinctive.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Do not choose only a language major. Combine the language with regional studies, literature and culture, or translation technology. Consider long-term demand and the institution's strength before selecting a less commonly taught language.
Use AI translation and teaching tools while deepening literary, cultural, and regional expertise. Build publications and project experience early to meet performance reviews.

Faculty positions are highly competitive, so consider language plus industry roles in cross-border commerce, localization, or international communication. On your resume, quantify translation work and describe cross-cultural projects and teaching outcomes.
Do not recruit only by language proficiency level. Assess research direction and AI teaching ability. Teachers who design AI-assisted, culturally analytical courses and produce research are scarce.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Quantitative analysis of style and narrative

ai_s7_trends: Language instruction is shifting toward AI-assisted teaching and cultural inquiry. Pure grammar and translation instruction is shrinking, and teachers are becoming cross-cultural guides.
Demand for regional and cross-cultural research is increasing. Teachers of less commonly taught languages are extending their work into combined language and regional studies.
AI literacy is becoming a basic teaching skill, and human-AI collaboration in instruction and research is becoming routine.

body: Foreign Language And Literature Teachers, Postsecondary teach non-English languages, literature, and translation at colleges and universities. They research the literature and culture of target-language countries, advise undergraduate and graduate theses, and support program development and international exchange.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把日语小说翻译出初稿、能批改德语语法，但带着学生读懂川端康成笔下的「物哀」，还得靠老师。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高校外语文学教师在岗约 2.64 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.64 万人，净增约 0.00 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.19 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 7.70 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高校外语教师，但会颠覆「教什么」。机器翻译和 AI 批改冲击纯语言技能教学，语言从「技能」变「门槛」；教师的价值转向文学阐释、跨文化研究和个性化指导。把 AI 当工具用起来，省下的时间带学生做深度文本与文化对话，反而是转型优势。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助文学文本分析
AI 文化内容生成辅助教学
ai_s2_auto: 语法与词汇批改自动化
ai_s3_list: 文学文本的细读阐释：物哀、存在主义，AI 给不出「为什么动人」。
跨文化比较研究：两种文化之间的桥，靠人搭。
课堂思辨的引导：把学生带进另一种思维，靠人。
个性化指导：学生语言短板和兴趣，只有老师清楚。
学术判断与原创：什么值得研究、结论可不可信，靠人把关。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业有相当比例的「语言加工」任务正被 AI 接管——翻译、批改、练习都能自动化，语言技能教学的价值在下降。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险。被冲击的是「纯语言技能型」教学，留下的是文学、文化和思辨价值。AI 翻译越强，越凸显「理解另一种文明」的人的稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 别只报「某某语专业」，要选「语种+方向」：区域国别、文学文化、翻译技术。选语种看长期需求，冷门语种要看清院校平台。
把 AI 翻译和教学工具用起来，深耕文学文化与区域国别研究，尽快积累论文和项目应对考核。
高校教职卷，可走「语言+产业」：跨境电商、本地化、国际传播。简历多写翻译量级、跨文化项目和教学成果。
招人别只看语种等级，要看研究方向和 AI 教学能力。能设计「AI 辅助+文化思辨」课堂、又有科研成果的教师，最稀缺。

ai_s7_trends: 语言教学转向「AI 辅助+文化思辨」，纯语法翻译教学萎缩，教师转型为跨文化引导者。
区域国别与跨文化研究需求上升，小语种教师的科研方向向「语言+区域」复合延伸。
AI 素养成为教师基本功，人机协作教学与研究成果为常态。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can schedule construction, but judging whether paint has the right consistency or a wall is level requires touch and sight. Those are the skills helpers learn on site.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 7,400 helpers to painters, paperhangers, plasterers, and stucco masons employed in 2024, projected to reach 7,600 by 2034. That is a net increase of about 200 jobs, with roughly 800 annual openings. Median annual pay is about $38,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace helpers. Moving materials, mixing compounds, and assisting are physical, collaborative tasks beyond AI's reach. AI can improve scheduling, material calculations, and work reporting, but people still prepare every batch and finish every wall.
ai_s2_accel: Spraying robots assist with large surfaces
ai_s2_auto: Digital construction schedules and material lists
ai_s3_list: Strength and endurance: demanding physical work is essential.
Awareness: understand what the craftsperson needs next.
Material feel: judge consistency, moisture, and proportions.
Site awareness: maintain safety and cleanliness together.
Learning the trade: master the craftsperson's techniques.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 4/10 score places helper work in a low-moderate exposure physical-support role. Scheduling and reporting are digitizing, but physical labor and field coordination cannot soon be automated. AI manages plans while people perform the work, so replacement risk comes mainly from the industry itself rather than AI.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure is no reason for complacency. Learn the craft while working rather than remaining limited to moving materials. Advancing to qualified craft work improves both income and security.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For students without an academic advantage, learning a trade is a practical path. Start under a reliable craftsperson and master painting, plastering, or paperhanging. Skilled-trade income and quality of life can compare well with office work. Choosing the right mentor and working diligently are essential.

Do not settle for helper status. Proactively learn paint mixing, putty application, and wallpaper installation, earn a trade certificate, and advance quickly to qualified craft work. With experience, contract projects or lead a crew for substantially more income potential.

Entering construction as a career-changing helper has a low barrier, but direction matters. Home renovation provides stable demand and suits beginners. Emphasize resilience, willingness to learn, and flexibility when connecting with employers. With the right mentor, develop the trade within two years.

Helper turnover is high, and retention depends on learning opportunities plus steady projects. A clear route from helper to qualified craftsperson for motivated workers costs less than constant replacement. Stable project flow encourages helpers to stay.

ai_s7_trends: An aging renovation workforce increases the value of learning and advancing.
As digital tools spread, helpers also need to report work through apps.
Home improvement and renovation demand remains stable while worksite safety requirements tighten.

body: Helpers to painters, paperhangers, plasterers, and stucco masons support skilled renovation workers on construction sites. They move materials, mix compounds, clean surfaces, prepare tools, and organize sites, making this an accessible support role in painting, paperhanging, and plastering.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can schedule construction, but judging whether paint has the right consistency or a wall is level requires touch and sight. Those are the skills helpers learn on site.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能排好施工计划，但「这一桶漆的稠度对不对、这面墙平不平」，得靠手摸、靠眼看，帮工跟着学出来的也是这些。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年帮工油漆工、裱糊工、抹灰工、灰泥泥瓦工在岗约 0.74 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.76 万人，净增约 0.02 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.08 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.81 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代帮工：搬料、调浆、打下手全是物理现场的体力与配合活，AI 够不着。AI 能帮的是排期、材料计算、报工管理，让工地更高效，但那一桶浆、那一面墙，还是得人来干。
ai_s2_accel: 墙面平整度激光扫描检测
喷涂机器人辅助大面作业
工地安全 AI 监控
ai_s2_auto: 施工排期与材料单数字化
ai_s3_list: 体力与耐力：重活累活是刚需。
眼力：看懂师傅下一步要什么。
材料手感：稠度、湿度、比例判断。
现场意识：安全与整洁同步跟进。
学艺吸收：把师傅的窍门学到手。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明帮工是「中高曝光」的体力辅助岗位：排期与报工被数字化，但体力劳动和现场配合短期无法自动化，属于「AI 管计划，人管干活」，替代风险主要来自行业本身而非 AI。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于能躺平：干活之余要把手艺学起来，别停在「只会搬料」，往正式工匠走，收入和安全感的提升都靠这个。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 学历不占优势的孩子，走「学一门手艺」的路线是务实的：跟着靠谱师傅从帮工做起，学成油漆、抹灰、裱糊任一门，手艺人的收入和生活不比坐办公室差。关键是找对师傅、肯下苦功。
别满足于帮工定位：主动学调漆、刮腻子、贴壁纸，考个工种证书，尽快转正式工匠；有一定经验后往包工带班走，收入按项目算，空间大得多。
转行进工地当帮工门槛低，但要选对方向：家装翻新需求稳定，适合新手；面试（对接时）突出能吃苦、肯学、不挑活。跟对师傅，两年内把手艺学出来。
帮工流动性大，留人靠「学艺机会 + 稳定活源」：给愿意学的帮工明确「学成转师傅」的路径，比不断换人划算；把活源排稳，帮工才愿意留下。

ai_s7_trends: 装修师傅老龄化，学艺转正的价值上升。
工具数字化普及，帮工也要会用 App 报工。
家装与翻新需求稳定，工地安全要求趋严。

body: 帮工油漆工、裱糊工、抹灰工与灰泥泥瓦工在工地为熟练装饰装修工人提供辅助，承担材料搬运、浆料搅拌、基面清理、工具准备与现场整理等工作，是油漆、裱糊。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能排好施工计划，但「这一桶漆的稠度对不对、这面墙平不平」，得靠手摸、靠眼看，帮工跟着学出来的也是这些。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can automatically calculate the thickness of the insulation and produce a cutting list, but the on-site skills of "how to place this elbow so as not to waste materials" still rely on the experienced craftsmen who pack the insulation.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that there will be approximately 27,200 mechanical insulation workers on the job in 2024, and the number is expected to rise to 28,500 by 2034, with a net increase of approximately 1,300 jobs, an average of approximately 2,300 job vacancies per year, and a median annual salary of approximately US$57,200 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace insulation workers: insulation construction is an on-site manual work, and special-shaped pipes need to be laid out, cut, and covered on site. Robots only cover prefabricated pipe fittings and simple spraying scenes. AI can help with peripheral matters such as material calculation, scheduling, and inspection, freeing the master from accounting, but the coating process itself cannot replace it.
ai_s2_accel: Popularity of prefabricated insulated pipe fittings
ai_s2_auto: Automatic material calculation and cutting order
Digitization of construction scheduling and acceptance records
ai_s3_list: Special-shaped lofting: Elbows and valves are produced on site.
Covering method: Seams are sealed to prevent leakage.
Material experience: material selection for different working conditions.
High-altitude work: pipe room and exterior wall construction.
Energy saving judgment: On-site discovery of insulation defects.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 shows that insulation work is a "medium to high exposure" on-site skill: measurement, cutting, and wrapping are all done by hand in a real environment. AI can only take over peripheral aspects such as material calculation, scheduling, and inspection, and the construction itself cannot replace it in a short time.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Don’t lie low for medium and high exposure: spraying robots and prefabricated pipe fittings are competing for regular jobs. Go to special projects such as cold storage, petrochemicals, and energy-saving testing, and learn to read thermal imaging data. You will upgrade from "insulation-savvy" to "energy-saving-savvy."

ai_s5_persona.建议: Young people who want to learn a craft can directly follow the apprenticeship class to develop a solid foundation in the basic skills of setting out and cladding. At the same time, it is recommended to learn a little bit about drawings and go to work as an insulation technician or manage energy-saving renovation projects, which has a better future than pure construction.

Go to the cold storage, petrochemical, and energy-saving inspection specialties, and take the insulation work-related certificates; learn thermal imaging inspection and material calculation tools, digitize on-site experience, and have a stronger quotation and voice.

Those with experience in piping, sheet metal, and waterproofing can apply: supplement knowledge on setting out and materials, focusing on handling special-shaped parts; during the interview, emphasize manual dexterity, the ability to endure hardships, and having a high-altitude working certificate.

It is difficult to recruit insulation workers, so it is recommended to retain people through "transparent piecework + special operation training + special project bonuses"; use prefabricated parts and spraying equipment to reduce physical strength, and put experienced hands on special-shaped parts and inspection links.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Factory prefabricated and installed on site

ai_s7_trends: Dual-carbon energy-saving transformation has driven continued growth in demand for insulation projects.
The popularity of prefabricated pipe fittings and spraying robots has reduced the number of regular construction workers.
The combination of thermal insulation construction and energy-saving testing makes composite skills more popular.

body: Thermal insulation workers (machinery direction) implement thermal insulation construction for pipes, equipment, air ducts, etc., carry out measurement and setting out, material cutting, cladding installation and shell processing, and participate in the construction of building exterior wall insulation systems to ensure thermal energy efficiency and safety.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能自动算保温厚度、出下料单，但「这个弯头怎么放样才不浪费料」的现场手艺，还得靠包保温的老师傅。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年机械保温隔热工在岗约 2.72 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.85 万人，净增约 0.13 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.23 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.72 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代保温工：保温施工是现场手艺活，异形管道要现场放样、裁剪、包覆，机器人只覆盖了预制管件和简单喷涂场景。AI 能帮的是算料、排期、检测这些外围事务，把师傅从算账里解放出来，但包覆工艺本身替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: 喷涂机器人施工平面保温
ai_s2_auto: 施工排期与验收记录数字化
ai_s3_list: 异形放样：弯头、阀门现场出型。
包覆手法：接缝密封不渗漏。
材料经验：不同工况的材料选型。
高空作业：管道间与外墙施工。
节能判断：保温缺陷的现场发现。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明保温工是「中高曝光」的现场手艺：测量、裁剪、包覆都在真实环境里靠手完成，AI 只能接管算料、排期、检测等外围，施工本身短时间替代不了。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光也别躺平：喷涂机器人和预制管件在抢常规活。往冷库、石化、节能检测这些专项走，学会看热成像数据，你会从「包保温的」升级成「懂节能的」。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想学手艺的年轻人可以直接跟班学徒，把放样和包覆基本功练扎实；同时建议学点识图，将来往保温技术员或节能改造项目管理走，比纯施工有前途。
往冷库、石化、节能检测专项走，考保温工相关证书；学会热成像检测和算料工具，把现场经验数字化，报价和话语权都更强。
有管道、钣金、防水经验的可以转：补上放样和材料知识，重点是异形件处理；面试时强调手巧、能吃苦、有高空作业证。
保温工难招，建议「计件透明 + 特种作业培训 + 专项项目奖金」留人；用预制件和喷涂设备减轻体力，把熟手放到异形件和检测环节上。

ai_s7_trends: 双碳节能改造带动保温工程需求持续增长。
预制管件与喷涂机器人普及，常规施工减人。
保温施工与节能检测结合，复合技能更吃香。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can calculate the best cutting plan, but how to fill the irregular cavity in the corner of the attic depends on your hands.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that there will be approximately 40,200 workers and floor workers in 2024, and this number is expected to rise to 41,700 by 2034, with a net increase of approximately 1,500 jobs, an average annual vacancy of approximately 3,400, and a median annual salary of approximately US$48,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace insulation workers, but it will take over desktop tasks such as measurement and calculation. Laser measurement plus software can automatically generate cutting plans and calculate accurate quantities, reducing the loss of "wasted materials". The remaining cutting, laying, compacting, and joint processing are all manual work, and machines cannot enter the construction site.
ai_s2_accel: Infrared thermal imaging detects insulation cavities and defects
AI-assisted quality inspection and defect marking
Online teaching and simulation of new material construction technology
Material and progress collaboration on project management platform
ai_s2_auto: Laser distance measurement and CAD calculation, automatic generation of cutting plan
Automatic calculation of insulation material usage and loss
Digital construction records and acceptance documents
Digital access to drawings and specification documents
ai_s3_list: On-site measurement and special-shaped cutting: irregular cavities and pipeline corners rely on eyes and hands.
Laying and compaction feel: You can feel whether the insulation layer is dense or not.
Seams and details: If one seam is not sealed, the insulation of the entire wall will be compromised.
Safety and occupational protection awareness: dust, heights, confined spaces, protective gear and judgment are indispensable.
Construction coordination: Cross-working with plumbing, bricklaying, and carpentry, on-site cooperation is a skill.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 shows that calculation, chart reading, and recording play a large role in this profession, and these are being rapidly taken over by measurement software and AI.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: But medium to high exposure does not equal high risk. AI helps workers calculate more accurately and perform inspections faster, which in turn makes workers who “can construct and understand specifications” more valuable. What is really being squeezed is the rough construction of "cutting materials based on feeling and causing serious waste". Masters who work meticulously are still popular.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you take the technician route, it is very promising to choose the direction of building energy conservation. Having a solid knowledge of drawings, measurements and new materials, and passing the safety and working at heights certificates will provide you with more experience than blindly changing work sites.

Learn to use laser distance measurement and material calculation software to reduce waste; obtain certificates related to thermal insulation workers, get exposed to new materials such as rock wool and aerogel, and upgrade to the direction of "technologist".

If you have no experience, start as an apprentice or a small worker. Learn protection first and then talk about craftsmanship. It is more effective to write more specific achievements such as "Independently completed XX square meters of insulation without rework" in your resume than to say "hard work and hard work".

When recruiting thermal insulation workers, ask about safety habits first and then about craftsmanship - people who don't wear protective gear should not be hired. Workers who can read drawings, use measuring tools, and accept work according to specifications are worthy of a higher unit price.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Quick measurement and automatic area calculation
Locating cavities, cold bridges and defects
Quick panel cutting and smooth edges
Drawing information is superimposed on site
Image recognition to mark construction defects

ai_s7_trends: Energy-saving standards continue to be tightened, the demand for thermal insulation construction is growing, and materials are being upgraded to be environmentally friendly and efficient.
Measurement and calculation are fully digitized, AI quality inspection assists acceptance, and the rework rate is reduced.
Licensing and safety supervision have become stricter, and standardized construction teams have become more popular in the market.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代保温工人，但会接管测量和算料这类桌面活。激光测量加软件能自动生成裁切方案、算准用量，把「浪费材料」的损耗降下来。剩下的切割、铺设、压实、接缝处理，全是手上的活，机器进不了施工现场。
ai_s2_accel: 红外热成像检测保温空腔与缺陷
AI 辅助的质量巡检与缺陷标注
新材料施工工艺的在线教学与模拟
项目管理平台的材料与进度协同
ai_s2_auto: 激光测距与 CAD 算料，裁切方案自动生成
保温材料用量与损耗的自动计算

ai_s3_list: 现场测量与异形裁剪：不规则空腔、管线转角，靠的是眼和手。
铺设与压实手感：保温层密不密实，摸得出来。
接缝与细部处理：一条缝没封好，整面墙的保温都打折。
安全与职业防护意识：粉尘、高处、密闭空间，护具和判断缺一不可。
施工协调：跟水电、瓦工、木工交叉作业，现场配合是门学问。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业的算料、读图、记录比重不小，这些正被测量软件和 AI 快速接管。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 帮工人算得更准、验得更快，反而让「会施工、懂规范」的工人更有价值。真正被挤压的是「凭感觉裁料、浪费严重」的粗糙施工，精工细作的师傅依然吃香。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 如果走技工路线，选建筑节能方向很有前途。把识图、测量和新材料知识学扎实，考下安全与高处作业证书，比盲目换工地更有积累。
学会用激光测距和算料软件，把浪费降下来；考取保温工相关证书，接触岩棉、气凝胶等新材料，往「工艺师」方向升级。
没经验就从学徒或小工做起，先学会防护再谈手艺。简历里多写「独立完成过XX平方保温、无返工」这类具体成果，比一句吃苦耐劳有用。
招保温工先问安全习惯再问手艺——护具都不戴的人不能要。会读图、会用测量工具、能按规范验收的工人，值得给更高单价。

测量算料全面数字化，AI 质检辅助验收，返工率下降。
持证与安全监管趋严，规范化施工队伍更受市场欢迎。

Focusing on error-free and complex cases, the company values ​​stability and accuracy.

Employment is projected to remain around 6,700 through 2034, with a net increase of about 0 jobs, roughly 1,200 openings per year, and a median annual wage of about $90,000 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace models, but it will reduce basic photo work. Virtual models and AI retouching are taking over e-commerce images and studio shoots, pushing models from basic appearances toward high-end runway work, expressive performance, brand alignment, and content creation. People who only do basic studio shoots will lose opportunities, while models with genuine presence will become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: On-set performance: people create the emotion.
Presence and fit: people judge the match.
Runway presence: people create the energy.
Brand understanding: people build the rapport.
Content creation: people shape the persona.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in the middle range of AI exposure for visual work. Systems accelerate basic studio photography, but human performance and presence still have a place.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Basic appearance work is being replaced, not roles requiring sophisticated performance. Models who are expressive and fit a brand become even scarcer as efficiency rises. The greatest risk is limiting yourself to basic studio work.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Develop camera presence and posture. Basic photography is shrinking in the AI era, so start building expressive and content skills early.
Progress from basic appearances to expressive performance + content creation. Learn branding and social media and aim to become a featured model.
Emphasize your portfolio and brand experience, and clearly list the shows you have worked. Agencies value reliability and consistent condition.
Do not choose talent based only on appearance. Look for models who understand performance. Core talent that can embody a brand is worth premium compensation.

ai_s7_trends: Virtual models become widespread, reducing basic work.
High-level performance creates opportunities.
Models who can build a persona become more sought after.

body: Models use posture, facial expression, and camera presence to showcase clothing, products, and brand images, communicating a visual tone and commercial message in photo shoots and runway shows.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 虚拟模特能生成基础图，但现场表现、气质与品牌契合，还是模特定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年模特在岗约 0.67 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.67 万人，净增约 0.00 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.12 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.00 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代模特，但会压缩基础拍摄。虚拟模特与 AI 修图接管电商图与棚拍，模特从「基础出镜」挪向「高级走秀、气质表现、品牌契合与内容创作」。真正被挤掉的是只做基础棚拍的人，有表现力的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 现场表现：情绪靠人。
气质契合：判断靠人。
走秀气场：状态靠人。
品牌理解：默契靠人。
内容创作：人设靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的视觉区——基础棚拍被系统加速，但表现与气质还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「基础出镜」动作，不是「高级表现」的岗位。有表现力、能契合品牌的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做基础棚拍的人。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 练镜头感与体态，AI 时代基础拍在缩，早点练表现与内容。
从「基础出镜」升级成「做表现 + 做内容」，学品牌与社媒，争取主推。
突出作品与品牌经历，写清接过哪些秀。经纪看重稳和状态。
选人别只看脸，要看有没有表现脑子。能契合品牌的骨干值得给高价。

ai_s7_trends: 虚拟模特普及，基础缩。
高级表现带来机会。
能做人设的更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can manage data and processes, but administrators still decide where resources should go and how to balance departments.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 226,600 postsecondary education administrators were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 230,500 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,900 jobs, with about 15,100 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $104,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace postsecondary education administrators, but it will accelerate analysis. Systems speed up enrollment forecasts, scheduling, and budgets, shifting management from spreadsheets toward institutional judgment, resource coordination, and reform implementation. Process-only administrators will be displaced, while people with operational judgment and coordination skills are more secure.
ai_s3_list: Institutional judgment: people set direction.
Resource coordination: people create balance.
Reform implementation: people drive change.
Relationship management: people build trust.
Crisis management: people exercise discretion.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 6/10 places this occupation in a moderately AI-exposed field. Systems accelerate data and processes, but institutional judgment still requires people.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. What accelerates is spreadsheet work and scheduling, not institutional leadership. People with operational judgment who coordinate well become scarcer as efficiency rises. Process-only administrators face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: During graduate study, practice management and data skills. Processes are shrinking in the AI era, so develop judgment early.
Advance from spreadsheets to operations management + coordination, and learn compliance and reform.
Emphasize the operations you managed and implementation cases.
When hiring, assess more than education; look for operational judgment.

ai_s7_trends: Comprehensive digitalization
Lower birth rates reduce demand
People with operational judgment are more sought after

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能管数据与流程，但哪块资源该倾斜、怎么平衡院系，还是主管定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年高等教育行政管理者在岗约 22.66 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 23.05 万人，净增约 0.39 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.51 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.40 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代高等教育行政管理者，但会加速分析环节。系统把招生预测、排课、预算提速，管理从「做表」挪向「办学判断、资源协调、改革落地」。真正被挤掉的是只做流程的，有运营脑子能协调的人更稳。
ai_s3_list: 办学判断：方向靠人。
资源协调：平衡靠人。
改革落地：推手靠人。
人际经营：信任靠人。
危机处理：分寸靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中等 AI 曝光区——数据与流程被系统加速，但办学判断还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被加速的是「做表排课」动作，不是「办学操盘」的岗位。有运营脑子、能协调的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只做流程的行政。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读研多练管理与数据，AI 时代流程在缩，早点练判断。
从「做表」升级成「管运营 + 协调」，学合规与改革。
突出管过哪些摊，写清落地案例。
选人别只看学历，要看有没有运营脑子。

ai_s7_trends: 数据化全面普及
少子化压需求
有运营脑子的人更抢手

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Collaboration tools can generate weekly reports automatically, but the PM still decides which workstream is failing, how to cut scope, and how to reassure the boss.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 1,046,300 project management specialists were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 1,105,000 by 2034, a net increase of about 58,700 jobs, with about 78,200 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $100,700 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace project management, but it will absorb basic tracking. Tools automate progress reports, meeting minutes, and risk alerts, shifting PMs from filling out forms and tracking progress to cross-team coordination, tradeoffs, contingency ownership, and stakeholder management. Pure messengers are most vulnerable, while people who take responsibility become more valuable.
ai_s3_list: People handle cross-team coordination.
People make tradeoff decisions.
People reassure stakeholders.
People take ownership of risks.
People align goals.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 means this occupation occupies a moderately high-exposure coordination zone. Systems accelerate basic tracking, but people retain their role in coordination and contingency ownership.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Filling out forms and tracking progress are being replaced, not cross-team coordination. PMs with business judgment who can carry risk become scarcer as efficiency improves. PMs who only relay messages without thinking face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: When starting from management or business studies, practice communication and tools. Pure tracking is shrinking in the AI era, so learn the business early.
Advance from tracking progress to making tradeoffs + carrying risk, and learn business and finance.
Highlight the scale of projects you managed and your cross-team experience. Companies value stability and accountability.
When hiring, look beyond certificates to whether candidates can take ownership. Core professionals who can handle complex projects deserve higher pay.

ai_s7_trends: Tools absorb basic tracking.
Complex projects still require people.
PMs who understand the business are more sought after.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代项目管理，但会吃掉基础跟踪。进度报表、会议纪要、风险提醒被工具自动化，PM 从「填表跟进度」挪向「跨团队协调、取舍兜底、 stakeholder 管理」。真正被挤掉的是纯传话型，能扛事的人更值钱。
ai_s3_list: 跨团队协调靠人。
取舍决策靠人。
stakeholder 安抚靠人。
风险兜底靠人。
目标对齐靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的协调区——基础跟踪被系统加速，但协调与兜底还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「填表跟进度」动作，不是「跨团队协调」的岗位。有业务感、能扛风险的 PM，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只传话不动脑的 PM。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 管科商科起步多练沟通和工具，AI 时代纯跟踪在缩，早点学业务。
从「跟进度」升级成「做取舍 + 扛风险」，学业务和财务。
突出跟过的项目规模和跨团队经验，公司看重稳和兜。
选人别只看证书，要看有没有兜底脑子。能扛复杂项目的骨干值得给高薪。

ai_s7_trends: 工具吃基础跟踪。
复杂项目仍要人。
懂业务的 PM 更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can monitor bonding data for every green tire in real time, but a builder's hands still smooth out bulges in the fabric layer on the building drum.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 20,900 tire builders were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 21,400 by 2034, a net increase of about 500 jobs, with approximately 2,500 openings annually. Median annual pay in 2026 is about $55,600 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace tire builders, but it will change how layers are assembled. Work that once depended entirely on people applying each layer is shifting toward automated tire-building machines and visual inspection. AI can monitor bonding quality and alert teams to anomalies in real time. People are still needed for on-site operations, exception handling, and equipment checks. Machines perform standard actions but do not replace judgment or response to unexpected events.
ai_s2_accel: AI bonding-quality prediction: Alerts teams early to bulging and misalignment risks
Predictive equipment maintenance: Vibration and temperature data drive fault alerts
Robotic loading and unloading: Reduces heavy manual handling
Digital-twin production lines: Virtual commissioning and process-parameter optimization
ai_s2_auto: Automated tire-building machines: Perform multilayer application and shaping according to programs
Visual inspection systems: AI automatically identifies bubbles, misalignment, and defects
Production scheduling systems: Automatically schedule orders, lines, and materials
Quality data collection: Automatically record and store parameters for every green tire
ai_s3_list: Tactile control during on-site application: Machines perform standard actions, while people handle anomalies manually.
Exception judgment and response: Experience determines how quickly to respond to equipment alarms and material anomalies.
Equipment inspection and communication: Workers handle minor faults and contact the correct maintenance team for major problems.
Quality responsibility: A defect in one green tire can require reworking an entire batch, making responsibility fundamental.
Cross-process coordination: People synchronize upstream and downstream processes and material flows.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means most work occurs on production lines. AI and automation assist and monitor on-site tasks such as bonding and shaping, but full replacement of human operation remains distant, especially in exception handling.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Automated building machines are reducing pure manual bonding roles across the industry. The strongest prospects belong to hybrid workers who operate automated equipment, inspect quality, and perform maintenance. The more machines a factory has, the more valuable people who can care for them become.

ai_s5_persona.建议: University is not required. Vocational programs in mechanics, CNC, or mechatronics combined with factory practice offer a strong path. Do not aim only for operator work. Study equipment maintenance and automation, because workers who understand equipment are most competitive in the AI era.

Do not remain limited to manual bonding. Build automated tire-building machine operation, equipment maintenance, and quality-inspection skills, advancing from operator to hybrid equipment operator and maintenance worker. Use factory training opportunities, because deeper skills provide greater protection from replacement.

Entry into a tire factory is accessible. Start as an operator while earning electrical, welding, or equipment-maintenance credentials. On your resume, quantify achievements such as machines operated, yield rate, and an accident-free safety record.

Do not recruit only for immediate task ability. Evaluate learning ability and stability. Workers who want to learn automated equipment, adapt to shifts, and demonstrate strong quality awareness are more worth developing than temporary labor. As lines automate, these people become future crew leaders.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Multilayer application, shaping, and controllable parameters
Automatic recognition of bubbles, misalignment, and defects
Automated scheduling of orders, lines, and materials
Vibration and temperature data drive fault alerts
Traceable records of every green tire's parameters
Operating standards, hazard inspections, and training records

ai_s7_trends: The tire industry remains stable with vehicle ownership and electric vehicle growth, but manufacturing automation accelerates and purely manual bonding roles continue to shrink.

Automated building machines + AI inspection become standard production-line equipment. Operation, maintenance, and data-driven quality roles increase, raising the value of workers who understand equipment.
Workers advance from bonding operators to hybrid technicians in automated line operation and maintenance, with substantially higher skill requirements.

body: Tire builders form green tires by applying rubber, fabric, steel beads, and related materials to building drums according to process requirements and operating building equipment to construct the tire carcass. This is a critical intermediate process in tire production.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能实时盯住每条胎胚的贴合数据，但成型鼓上那层帘布有没有鼓包，还得靠制造工的手去抹平。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年轮胎制造工在岗约 2.09 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 2.14 万人，净增约 0.05 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.25 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.56 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代轮胎制造工，但会改变「贴合」这件事的形态。以前全靠人工一层层贴合，现在自动化成型机加视觉检测系统正在普及，AI 能实时监控贴合质量、预警异常。可现场操作、异常处理、设备点检这些环节，还得靠人——机器会做标准动作，但不替你做判断和处理突发。
ai_s2_accel: AI 贴合质量预测：提前预警鼓包、偏位风险
设备预测维护：振动、温度数据驱动故障预警
机器人辅助上下料：减轻重体力搬运
数字孪生产线：虚拟调试与工艺参数优化
ai_s2_auto: 自动化成型机：按程序完成多层贴合与定型
视觉检测系统：AI 自动识别气泡、错位与瑕疵
生产排产系统：订单、产线、物料自动排程
质量数据采集：每胎胚参数自动记录入库
ai_s3_list: 现场贴合的手感：机器做标准动作，异常时的手工处理还靠人。
异常判断与处理：设备报警、材料异常时，怎么快速应对，靠经验。
设备点检与沟通：小故障自己能处理，大问题要找对维修班。
质量责任意识：一条胎胚的瑕疵可能造成整批返工，责任心是底线。
跨工序协作：上下工序的衔接、物料协调，靠人把节奏对上。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业大部分工作在产线上——贴合、定型这些现场任务，AI 和自动化能辅助和监控，但离「完全替人操作」还有距离，尤其异常处理环节。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。纯手工贴合岗确实在被自动化成型机挤压，这是产业升级，不是某一家的问题。真正有前景的是「会操作自动化设备、会质检、会维护」的复合型工人——机器越多，会伺候机器的人越值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 不必读大学，技校/中职的机械、数控、机电一体化专业加进厂实践是好路线。别只奔着「操作工」，往设备维护、自动化方向学，AI 时代懂设备的工人最吃香。
别满足于纯手工贴合。把自动化成型机操作、设备维护、质检技能补起来，从「操作工」升级为「设备操作与维护复合型工人」。工厂培训机会要抓住，技能越深越不怕被替代。
进轮胎厂门槛不高，先从操作工做起，边做边考电工、焊工、设备维护类证书。简历上写「操作机台数、良品率、无安全事故」这类可量化成果。
招人别只看「能不能上手」，要看学习能力和稳定性。愿意学自动化设备、能适应倒班、质量意识强的工人，比临时用工更值得培养——产线自动化后，这样的人就是班组长后备。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 多层贴合、定型、参数可控
气泡、错位、瑕疵自动识别
订单、产线、物料自动排程
振动温度数据驱动故障预警
每胎胚参数记录可追溯
操作规范、隐患排查、培训记录

ai_s7_trends: 轮胎行业随汽车保有量和新能源车增长保持稳定，但制造端自动化加速，纯手工贴合岗持续收缩。
自动化成型机加 AI 质检成为主流产线配置，操作、维护、数据质检岗位增加，懂设备的工人价值上升。
工人角色从「贴合操作工」升级为「自动化产线操作与维护复合型技师」，技能要求明显提高。
